en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ibn Mabbah, from so and so Bin Humeyd, 
He asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and consulted him<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the naming of his child. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Name him by the names from the slavery’. So he said, ‘Which names are these?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Abd Al-Rahman’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-FIakam from ibn Mayyah from Fulan ibn Flamid ibn Flamid who has said the following: “I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, for advice about
the name of my child and he (the Imam) said, ‘Name him with the names that express slavery (to Allah).’ He then asked, ‘Which ones are they?’ He (the Imam) said, “Abd al-Rahman.’”
